### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you looking to be part of a dynamic team who support sport fish conservation? The California Department of Fish and Wildlife’s Bay Delta Region\-Hatchery Operations and Interpretive Services Unit serves the public by enhancing recreational angling opportunities, managing sport fish populations, and providing outreach and educational programs that strengthen stewardship across the region.The Hatchery Operations and Interpretive Services Unit is seeking a motivated individual to work as a Environmental Scientist located in beautiful Sonoma County in Santa Rosa, California. You will play a key role implementing a Hatchery Genetic Management Plan (HGMP), as well as providing critical scientific and technical support for our hatchery operations.  

  

  

Under the close supervision of the Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory), this position supports the California Department of Fish and Wildlife’s Bay Delta Region hatchery operations by helping ensure Warm Springs Hatchery and Coyote Valley Fish Facility meet production, genetic management, and Endangered Species Act requirements for the Russian River steelhead program. The role analyzes biological and operational data, manages AquaManager databases, assists with NPDES water\-quality compliance, and supports aquatic invasive species monitoring. It also contributes to the Sport Fish Restoration Program by coordinating regional fish stocking, conducting fisheries and habitat assessments, developing management plans, and overseeing freshwater fishing contest permits and sport\-fish regulation recommendations.
  

  

Additionally, the position leads outreach and stakeholder engagement, evaluates regulation effectiveness, and provides technical expertise to Tribes, agencies, NGOs, and the public on warmwater and coldwater fisheries management.  

  

  

Be essential at the California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW), where employees are valued and come together to manage and protect California’s diverse fish, wildlife, and habitats, for their ecological values and public enjoyment!

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Partial office setting using a computer keyboard and Microsoft Office software several hours a day. Work outdoors includes completing tasks in varying weather conditions and walking on uneven surfaces. Must have ability to swim at least fifty (50\) yards and stay afloat for at least five (5\) minutes. Must be able to move forty (40\) pounds. Occasionally work weekends and holidays based upon operational need. Must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to operate a motor vehicle to travel (up to 25%) to Warm Springs Hatchery (WSH), Coyote Valley Fish Facility (CVFF), and fieldwork as required, including night, weekend, and holiday work on occasion. Must be able to operate the vehicle while trailering a vessel. Must be able to work aboard and operate a motorized vessel. Must possess California Boater Card and will be required to obtain a Motorboat Operator Training Course (MOTC) certificate. Typical work hours are 0730 \- 1600 hours.  

  

  

This position is located in Santa Rosa, California with expected travel to WSH and CVFF facilities, and field sites as needed.

jobs.description:
**Make your next move an expert one.**

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.


**Why Colliers?**

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.  



  

***\*\*\*This position is for a Sustainability Analyst in Sacramento, California \*\*\*\****

  

**About This Role**
-------------------

As part of the **REMS** team at Lincoln Plaza , the Sustainability Analyst will work with the Senior Project Manager on sustainability initiatives, environmental data tracking and reporting, management of service contracts related to environmental services and consultants, and collaboration with the Client's Sustainability team.  



  

* You will work directly with the Client, consultants, contractors, and internal staff to develop workflows for the LEED recertification process, including planning meetings, data collection and entry, tracking, and documentation. You will successfully track market activity using internal and external resources and provide company and industry research using online and in\-house resources.
* You will stay current on trends in sustainability, conservation, and green building operations. You will effectively collect, input, and track energy and water consumption data through EPA's ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager and provide reports as requested. You will also track and report on federal, state, and local sustainability performance mandates.
You will successfully manage the existing LEED certification program for two (2\) Class A and one (1\) Class B office buildings. You will thrive in a fast\-paced environment where you can use your exceptional multitasking skills to meet tight deadlines while maintaining the highest standards of ethics and integrity.  
* 

  

**Essential Functions and Job Duties**
--------------------------------------

* Collect, analyze, and report sustainability performance data for buildings and operations.
* Manage and support reporting activities with The Climate Registry and other environmental reporting platforms.
* Coordinate and support LEED certification and recertification efforts across multiple facilities.
* Assist with WELL Building Standard and WELL Health\-Safety Rating initiatives.
* Monitor and track ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager performance metrics and benchmarking activities.
* Conduct sustainability assessments and identify opportunities for energy, water, waste, and carbon reduction, including quarterly water testing, indoor air quality (IAQ) testing, greenhouse gas inventories, and compliance with state mandates, executive orders, and Senate bills.
* Support environmental compliance programs and sustainability initiatives.
* Research and evaluate emerging sustainability trends, technologies, and best practices.
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for leadership and stakeholders.
* Collaborate with facility managers, consultants, contractors, and project teams to implement sustainability goals.
* Maintain documentation and records related to environmental programs, certifications, and sustainability reporting requirements.
Support organizational ESG and sustainability objectives through data analysis and performance measurement.  
* 

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* At least two (2\) years of experience in environmental science, research, market analysis, or a related role within commercial real estate. A bachelor's degree in Environmental Science or a related field (Business, Economics, Statistics, etc.) is required.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using various data sources and reporting platforms.
* LEED Green Associate (GA), LEED Accredited Professional (AP), ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager, or CRIS experience is considered an asset.
Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience in sustainability, environmental management, green building, energy management, or a related field.  
* 

  

**Required Certifications (or Ability to Obtain Within 12 Months of Hire)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* LEED Green Associate (LEED GA), or
LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP)  
* 

  

**Required Knowledge and Demonstrated Experience with the Following**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* The Climate Registry
* U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) programs
* LEED building certifications
* WELL Health\-Safety Rating
* WELL Building Standard
* ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager
* Green building and sustainability practices
* Environmental performance reporting and benchmarking
Sustainability metrics and data analysis  
* 

  

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including: Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, dashboards) Word PowerPoint Outlook
* Ability to analyze large datasets and develop meaningful reports and recommendations.
Experience with sustainability tracking and reporting tools is preferred.  
* 

  

**Communication Skills**
------------------------

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate technical sustainability information to diverse audiences.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to prepare professional reports, executive summaries, and recommendations.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting sustainability programs for commercial real estate, facilities

jobs.title: Environmental Health Specialist
jobs.description:
**About FACS**


At FACS, our mission is to make environments safer and healthier for the people who live and work in them. As one of the nation's leading environmental health consulting firms, we help organizations protect their people, assets, and communities. We are built on purpose, partnership, and performance, delivering measurable impact with every client engagement.

**Our Values**


We live our mission through three core values:

* **People First:** Support our team and clients, promote professional growth, and value collaboration.
* **Integrity of the Science:** Deliver accurate, reliable results through objective, evidence\-based practices.
* **Client Relationships for Life:** Build long\-term partnerships and help clients address environmental health challenges.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact:** Contribute meaningful work that empowers teams and drives results across the organization.
* **Culture:** Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission\-driven environment where your work matters.
* **Growth:** Innovate, develop your skills, and help shape the future of how we operate and deliver on our mission.
* **Visibility:** Partner directly with leadership and cross\-functional teams to make a real difference.


Ranked "Best Places to Work" for five consecutive years, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and support for professional certifications—so you can grow, thrive, and build a career with lasting impact.

*Curious to see what we do? Meet our team at* FACS Experts.


**About the Role:**


The Environmental Health Specialist will support public health and well\-being by conducting fieldwork and environmental assessments for a variety of environmental health and industrial hygiene projects. Under the direction of Project Managers, you will support projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.


This is a field\-based role that requires regular travel to local client sites and occasional travel outside the local area, depending on project needs. You will collect samples and field data, document site conditions, prepare accurate field notes, and communicate project updates to Project Managers.


This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on work, takes pride in accuracy and professionalism, and is eager to develop technical experience in environmental health and industrial hygiene. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong attention to detail, reliability, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to learn beyond their current comfort zone.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform assigned fieldwork and project tasks under the direction of Project Managers.
* Travel regularly to local client sites and occasionally to out\-of\-area locations based on project needs.
* Support environmental health and industrial hygiene projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.
* Review project scopes, site requirements, and field protocols to ensure a clear understanding of assigned work.
* Collect field data and samples in accordance with established procedures, project specifications, and safety requirements.
* Conduct site observations and document field conditions accurately and thoroughly.
* Prepare, organize, maintain, and transport the tools, equipment, and supplies needed for assigned fieldwork.
* Maintain detailed field notes; compile data; and summarize findings to support project reporting and analysis.
* Communicate regularly with Project Managers regarding project status, technical questions, field conditions, and next steps.
* Report progress, concerns, and deviations from project scope or established protocols promptly.
* Interact professionally and collaboratively with clients, contractors, building occupants, and other stakeholders at project sites.
* Follow all company safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment.
* Participate actively in training, mentorship, and professional\-development opportunities to build technical knowledge in environmental health and industrial hygiene.
* Support the delivery of high\-quality, timely client service while maintaining FACS’s standards for accuracy, professionalism, and integrity.

**What You Bring:**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
* Reliable, professional, and able to follow field protocols, safety requirements, and project instructions.
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, current auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards.
* Ability to travel regularly to local client sites, with occasional out\-of\-area travel as needed.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of this field\-based role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends based on project requirements.

**Preferred**

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Fieldwork or related experience in environmental services, construction, facilities, EHS, restoration, inspection, sampling, or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, or air and exposure sampling

**Physical \& Work Requirements**

* Ability to perform field\-based work at client sites, including stooping, kneeling, climbing, crawling, and accessing a variety of areas to collect samples.
* Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment and instruments weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and complete job\-related medical surveillance and respirator fit testing, as required for assigned work and consistent with applicable law.
* Ability to work at a desk and use a computer for extended periods to complete documentation and reporting.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation\-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment \& Health, Water, Energy, and Planning \& Urban Design.

 **Job Description**  

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.


Are you eager to develop your technical and professional excellence and advance your career in a collaborative, inclusive, diverse, and empowering culture? Ramboll is a leading scientific and environmental consulting firm providing a broad range of technical services to both public and private sector clients. When you join Ramboll, you will become part of a company that strives to make a difference – for our employees, clients, and society.


Ramboll is seeking an entry\-level to mid\-level consultant to join the Risk Assessment and Community Health group in one of the firm’s Oakland, CA office. Hybrid work arrangements are available, with office presence required at least two days a week.

**Your new role**


As an entry\-level health sciences consultant at Ramboll, you will support a range of human health risk assessment and community health projects in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment. Your work will include independent, detail\-oriented technical tasks as well as coordination with colleagues and project teams. Projects may be related to hazardous waste and other contaminated sites, Brownfield redevelopment, vapor intrusion, ambient and indoor air quality, product safety, regulatory interactions, community engagement, and litigation. Tasks may include data management, statistical analysis, fate and transport modeling, spatial analysis, sampling/remediation/risk management planning, and technical reporting. This is a unique opportunity to work with Ramboll experts to advance your technical and consulting skills.

**Your key responsibilities will be:**

* Compiling, organizing, and managing environmental data and databases; performing statistical and geospatial analyses of environmental and health data.
* Evaluating the environmental fate and transport of chemicals
* Estimating human exposures to chemicals in different environmental media (e.g., air, soil, sediment, fish tissue, produce, water, etc.) and exposure scenarios, and calculating associated health risks.
* Assisting with preparation of technical reports, written communication, proposals, and presentations
* Reviewing and evaluating technical documents (e.g., scientific articles, regulations)

  

**Qualifications** **About you**


From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your professional development and advancement in the company! Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Advanced degree (M.S., MPH or equivalent) in Environmental Science or Engineering, Environmental Health Science and/or Environmental Toxicology
* Exemplary individuals with bachelor’s degree and 2 \+ years of relevant experience may be considered.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, organizational, problem\-solving, critical thinking skills, and time management skills; excellent written and oral communication skills
* 2\+ years of chemistry coursework required.
* Current authorization to work in the United States on a full\-time basis, where required for the position.


Preferred Skills and Experience:

* Knowledge of risk assessment, exposure assessment, and fate and transport of chemicals in the environment
* Proficiency with MS Office; experience with MS Access or other relational databases (e.g., SQL) for managing, querying, and analyzing environmental data.
* Demonstrated strong quantitative and problem\-solving skills; experienced with statistical and data analysis using R, Python, SQL, or SAS
* GIS capability is a plus.
* Experience reviewing and evaluating technical documents, scientific articles, regulations, and regulatory guidance.

  

**Additional Information** **What we can offer you**

* Meaningful, high\-impact work
* Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Professional development and leadership opportunities
* A collaborative and inclusive culture
* The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company

**Salary Transparency Statement**


At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $79,040–$98,800 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well\-being, professional development, and work\-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.pe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**  

Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories, a nationally recognized laboratory, is searching for Environmental Monitoring Scientists to support our Professional Scientific Services group in San Diego, CA.

**Environment Monitoring Scientist responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following****:**

* Aseptically collect Environmental Monitoring (EM), cleaning validation, and ICP testing samples at ca biologics facility using sampling protocols and associated documents.
* Ensure compliance with GMP policies and SOPs in a production environment.
* Aseptically gown and work in sterile manufacturing areas
* Perform QC testing such as Bioburden, Endotoxin, Total Organic Carbon, Concentration, and Conductivity
* Maintain and Ensure sample chain of custody using a LIMS system and perform all aspects of Sample management including aliquoting, storage, receipt, and shipping.
* Review manufacturing schedule for dynamic environmental monitoring to ensure all samples are collected appropriately, and address problems where necessary.
* Review and reconcile all environmental monitoring samples at the end of the production run to ensure all samples were appropriately taken, processed, and were within required limits.
* Weekend, holiday, and overtime work may be required as needed to meet production schedules.
* Perform Laboratory and Equipment maintenance
* Participate in lean lab operation, 6S laboratory layout, preventive action, and continuous improvement programs to reduce operating costs.
* Calculate, evaluate, review, and properly communicate data verbally and in written format.

  

**Qualifications** **The ideal candidate would possess****:**

* Experience with microbiology, sterile technique, Empower software, and working in a GMP biologics production environment
* Strong computer, scientific, and organizational skills
* Excellent communication (oral and written) and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self\-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude
* Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in microbiology, life sciences, or other related degree concentration
* At least 1 year related laboratory experience (microbiology and environmental monitoring in a GMP biologics facility preferred)
* Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

  

**Additional Information** **What we offer:**

* Comprehensive medical coverage, with dental and vision options
* Life and disability insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid holidays and vacation
* Compensation Range: $52,000 \- $57,000K


Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories Professional Scientific Services® (PSS) is a global, award\-winning insourcing solution that places our people at our clients’ site dedicated to running and managing laboratory services while eliminating headcount, co\-employment and project\-management worries.


We infuse our 55\-year track record of scientific and laboratory operations expertise, as well as HR and great place to work best practices, to recruit, hire, train and manage highly qualified scientists to perform laboratory services using our client’s quality systems and equipment.

**We are looking forward to receiving your application including your expected salary and possible start date via our career website.**

**Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **Program Overview**


Provide critical communications and tracking for multiple spacecraft from three complexes located globally, and operates year round 24 hours/7days to provide continuous contact with the spacecraft. The program fulfills NASA goals by supporting NASA deep space mission set, including NASA\-funded missions and collaborative international missions.
##### **About The Role**


Peraton is seeking an **Environmental Analyst** to support our Deep Space Network (DSN) Operations and Maintenance contract with NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Fort Irwin, CA.

  

The Deep Space Network is NASA’s international array of giant radio antennas that supports interplanetary spacecraft missions, plus a few that orbit Earth. The DSN also provides radar and radio astronomy observations that improve our understanding of the solar system and the larger universe. The antennas of the Deep Space Network are the indispensable link to explorers venturing beyond the moon. They provide the crucial connection for commanding our spacecraft and receiving their never\-before\-seen images and scientific information on Earth, propelling our understanding of the universe, our solar system and ultimately, our place within it.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

The Environmental Analyst supports and manages environmental compliance programs, regulatory reporting, data analysis, inspections, and permitting. The role requires the ability to interpret federal, state, and local environmental regulations and translate them into practical compliance programs, working closely with EHS, operations, engineering, facilities, maintenance, and management.

  

**Compliance and Reporting:**


* Monitor compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including those administered by the EPA, state agencies, air quality management districts, and water quality boards
* Conduct compliance inspections and assessments, identify gaps, and develop corrective actions
* Maintain environmental permits, licenses, registrations, records, and regulatory documentation
* Prepare and submit required environmental reports and notifications
* Track regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on operations
* Support environmental audits and agency inspections
  

**Air Quality and Wastewater:**


* Support air permitting and compliance, including records for emissions, permitted equipment, and operating parameters
* Assist with emissions calculations, testing, monitoring, and corrective actions
* Support industrial and sanitary wastewater compliance programs
  

**Environmental Management and Incident Response:**


* Support development and maintenance of environmental management systems and continuous improvement initiatives
* Investigate and document environmental incidents, spills, and releases; coordinate corrective and preventive actions
* Support regulatory notifications, agency communications, and emergency response involving environmental releases
##### **Qualifications**


**Required Qualifications:**

  

* BS/BA and 2 years of experience; or MS/MA and 0 years; or 6 years with no degree
* Strong working knowledge of EPA regulations and applicable federal, state, and local environmental requirements
* Experience conducting environmental inspections, audits, and compliance assessments
* Experience with environmental reporting and regulatory documentation
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple regulatory deadlines independently
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
* U.S. citizenship with proof of citizenship; must be able to obtain a trusted background check and pass a National Criminal Information Check (NCIC)
* Must possess and retain a valid California Real ID driver's license
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Occupational Safety, or a related field
* Experience with California Environmental Regulations and agencies such as Cal/OSHA, DTSC, Mojave Desert or South Coast AQMD, and Regional Water Quality Control Boards
* Experience with hazardous waste, air quality, stormwater, wastewater, SPCC, and environmental permitting
* Experience with environmental management systems (ISO 14001\) and EHS data management software
* Experience developing compliance procedures and training programs
* Professional certification such as CHMM or CEP
  
##### **Details**


**Target Salary Range:** $51,000 \- $82,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.


**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability

**About FACS**


At FACS, our mission is to make environments safer and healthier for the people who live and work in them. As one of the nation's leading environmental health consulting firms, we help organizations protect their people, assets, and communities. We are built on purpose, partnership, and performance, delivering measurable impact with every client engagement.

**Our Values**


We live our mission through three core values:

* **People First:** Support our team and clients, promote professional growth, and value collaboration.
* **Integrity of the Science:** Deliver accurate, reliable results through objective, evidence\-based practices.
* **Client Relationships for Life:** Build long\-term partnerships and help clients address environmental health challenges.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact:** Contribute meaningful work that empowers teams and drives results across the organization.
* **Culture:** Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission\-driven environment where your work matters.
* **Growth:** Innovate, develop your skills, and help shape the future of how we operate and deliver on our mission.
* **Visibility:** Partner directly with leadership and cross\-functional teams to make a real difference.


Ranked "Best Places to Work" for five consecutive years, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and support for professional certifications—so you can grow, thrive, and build a career with lasting impact.

*Curious to see what we do? Meet our team at* FACS Experts.


**About the Role:**


The Environmental Health Specialist will support public health and well\-being by conducting fieldwork and environmental assessments for a variety of environmental health and industrial hygiene projects. Under the direction of Project Managers, you will support projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.


This is a field\-based role that requires regular travel to local client sites and occasional travel outside the local area, depending on project needs. You will collect samples and field data, document site conditions, prepare accurate field notes, and communicate project updates to Project Managers.


This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on work, takes pride in accuracy and professionalism, and is eager to develop technical experience in environmental health and industrial hygiene. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong attention to detail, reliability, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to learn beyond their current comfort zone.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform assigned fieldwork and project tasks under the direction of Project Managers.
* Travel regularly to local client sites and occasionally to out\-of\-area locations based on project needs.
* Support environmental health and industrial hygiene projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.
* Review project scopes, site requirements, and field protocols to ensure a clear understanding of assigned work.
* Collect field data and samples in accordance with established procedures, project specifications, and safety requirements.
* Conduct site observations and document field conditions accurately and thoroughly.
* Prepare, organize, maintain, and transport the tools, equipment, and supplies needed for assigned fieldwork.
* Maintain detailed field notes; compile data; and summarize findings to support project reporting and analysis.
* Communicate regularly with Project Managers regarding project status, technical questions, field conditions, and next steps.
* Report progress, concerns, and deviations from project scope or established protocols promptly.
* Interact professionally and collaboratively with clients, contractors, building occupants, and other stakeholders at project sites.
* Follow all company safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment.
* Participate actively in training, mentorship, and professional\-development opportunities to build technical knowledge in environmental health and industrial hygiene.
* Support the delivery of high\-quality, timely client service while maintaining FACS’s standards for accuracy, professionalism, and integrity.

**What You Bring:**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
* Reliable, professional, and able to follow field protocols, safety requirements, and project instructions.
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, current auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards.
* Ability to travel regularly to local client sites, with occasional out\-of\-area travel as needed.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of this field\-based role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends based on project requirements.

**Preferred**

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Fieldwork or related experience in environmental services, construction, facilities, EHS, restoration, inspection, sampling, or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, or air and exposure sampling

**Physical \& Work Requirements**

* Ability to perform field\-based work at client sites, including stooping, kneeling, climbing, crawling, and accessing a variety of areas to collect samples.
* Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment and instruments weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment and complete job\-related medical surveillance and respirator fit testing, as required for assigned work and consistent with applicable law.
* Ability to work at a desk and use a computer for extended periods to complete documentation and reporting.
